about: ADR-013 § 9: the ONE rule catalogue for /hygiene (doctor hygiene, ids NH-*) and /fleet-doctor (doctor fleet-doctor, ids FD-*). Both skills cite these ids; the doctor-report validator (packages/doctor-report.nix) checks every run against this file. Hygiene rules carry a SARIF level (note|warning|error); fleet-doctor rules carry the health-check status a finding reads (warn|fail) and the component:measurement key it reports under. Severity is fixed here, never chosen per run.

rules.shortDescription: A path's CLAUDE.md one-liner and its docs/map section disagree, or a top-level path is in neither
rules.detect: ls the top-level and modules/* directories at the subject SHA; for each, read its CLAUDE.md § Navigating row and the docs/map file docs/repo-map.md routes it to; compare
evidence: the two sentences that disagree, or the index that omits it
rules.fixHint: fix BOTH the CLAUDE.md one-liner and the docs/map section, or delete the claim

rules.shortDescription: A user-facing flake app has no source file or no runbook mention
rules.detect: nix build the hosts-documented check (it renders the app list); for each app, grep docs/ for `.#<app>`
evidence: the grep that found no mention

rules.shortDescription: A runbook names an app or path that no longer exists
rules.detect: grep -rnoE 'nix run \.#[a-z0-9-]+' docs/*-runbook.md and check each app exists; same for backticked repo paths
evidence: the runbook file and the construct

rules.shortDescription: Two live implementations of one thing (an old and a new path) where one is abandoned
rules.detect: judgment over modules/, packages/ and hosts/: two modules or options owning the same service or fact
evidence: which one the hosts actually use

rules.shortDescription: A commented-out code block with no stated near-term intent
rules.detect: grep -rnE '^\s*#\s*[a-zA-Z_.]+\s*=' --include=*.nix modules hosts packages; judge each hit
evidence: the file and the binding the block comments out

rules.shortDescription: A declared option or let binding nothing reads (beyond what deadnix/statix catch)
rules.detect: for each mkOption under modules/, grep the tree for its attribute path outside its own declaration

rules.shortDescription: A vendored copy of upstream code whose one-line why-not-upstream justification is missing or expired
rules.detect: grep -rniE 'vendor|forked|copied from' --include=*.nix .; for each, re-check the pinned input for the option it lacked
evidence: the pinned input grep showing the option is still absent, or now present

rules.shortDescription: One fact stated in two places (code or docs) that can drift
rules.detect: judgment: the same literal, list or claim in two files; deliberate duplicates (deny lists combining across scopes) are not findings

rules.shortDescription: A host-specific list in a shared module without an isMacosHost or local.* gate (or gated on the hostname)
rules.detect: grep -rnE 'networking.hostName|hostName ==' modules/; read shared modules for host-only packages or agents outside lib.mkIf

rules.shortDescription: A launchd unit without a nix-<kebab> arg0 or bypassing launchd-launcher.nix
rules.detect: grep -rn 'launchd\.\(agents\|daemons\|user\)' modules hosts; check each ProgramArguments arg0 per .claude/rules/launchd-naming.md

rules.shortDescription: A secret value (not a name) in a .nix file
rules.detect: the pre-commit check's gitleaks plus judgment over strings that look like tokens; never print the value
evidence: the file and binding (never the value)

rules.shortDescription: A *-plan wrapper without passthru.terranixDriftEnv (runs credential-less in the drift agent)
rules.detect: grep -n 'terranixDriftEnv' modules/parts/terranix.nix and compare with every *-plan package

rules.shortDescription: A comment restating what the code does instead of why
rules.detect: judgment while reading the scope's .nix files
evidence: the file and construct the comment sits on

rules.shortDescription: A 'we tried X then Y' narrative that prevents no known footgun
rules.detect: grep -rniE 'we tried|first attempt|then we|originally' --include=*.nix .; judge each

rules.shortDescription: A runbook or skill frontmatter command that no longer matches the current command or flags
rules.detect: for each command block in docs/*-runbook.md and .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md, check the binary and flags against the package source
evidence: the current form, with the file that defines it

rules.shortDescription: A number in the docs (checks, capsules, rules, hosts, files) that the live count contradicts
rules.detect: grep -rnE '\b[0-9]+ (checks|capsules|rules|hosts|files|stacks|secrets)\b' docs CLAUDE.md .claude; compare each with the live count from ls or a nix build
evidence: the claimed number and the measured number
rules.fixHint: delete the count or point at the generated table; never restate a new count

rules.shortDescription: A dated or status claim ('still open', 'unmeasured', 'not yet') that code, CI or git history now contradicts
rules.detect: grep -rniE 'still open|not yet|unmeasured|TODO|pending' docs CLAUDE.md .claude; check each against git log / gh
evidence: the commit, run or PR that contradicts it

rules.shortDescription: A skill, command, rule or workflow under .claude/ missing from CLAUDE.md's lists or docs/map/claude-code.md
rules.detect: ls .claude/{skills,commands,rules,workflows}; grep CLAUDE.md and docs/map/claude-code.md for each name

rules.shortDescription: A custom shim (home.activation, activation script, wrapper, symlink farm) without the upstream-first justification, or one the pinned input now makes obsolete
rules.detect: grep -rn 'home.activation\|system.activationScripts\|home.file' modules; for each, grep the pinned input source per .claude/rules/upstream-first.md

rules.shortDescription: A shell script built with writeShellScript(Bin) or writeScript where writeShellApplication (shellcheck) fits
rules.detect: grep -rn 'writeShellScript\|writeScriptBin\|writeScript ' --include=*.nix .

rules.shortDescription: An environment.etc entry for something nix-darwin or NixOS models as an option
rules.detect: grep -rn 'environment.etc' modules hosts; grep the pinned input for an option owning the same file
evidence: the option that owns it, from the pinned source

rules.shortDescription: nix.enable = true or a hand-written nix.custom.conf on the darwin host (Determinate Nix owns it)
rules.detect: grep -rnE 'nix\.enable|nix\.custom\.conf|nix\.settings' modules/darwin hosts/macos.nix hosts/generic-darwin.nix

rules.shortDescription: A forAllSystems fold or genAttrs systems where flake-parts perSystem fits (ADR-002)
rules.detect: grep -rnE 'forAllSystems|forAll |genAttrs (systems|darwinSystems|linuxSystems)' --include=*.nix .

rules.shortDescription: A capsule smuggling a value out through specialArgs, an overlay or a runtime store path (invisible to ast-grep and capsule-registry)
rules.detect: grep -rn 'specialArgs\|overlays\|_module.args' modules/features; judge each against ADR-002 § 7.6

rules.shortDescription: The mechanical gate is red at the subject SHA: nix fmt rewrites a file, or nix flake check (--all-systems --no-build, then the suite) fails
rules.detect: in the origin/<default> snapshot: nix fmt then git status --porcelain; nix flake check --all-systems --no-build; nix flake check
evidence: the failing command and its exit code
the first failing check or the rewritten file
rules.vacuousWhen: the gate was not run (say why: nix unavailable)

rules.shortDescription: File rotation on the shared ~/Downloads enabled for a guest (mv across filesystems destroys host files)
rules.detect: grep -rn 'Downloads' modules hosts; check every rotation agent is host-only
evidence: the module and the host it is enabled on

rules.shortDescription: A .utm bundle, IPSW or disk image tracked in the flake
rules.detect: git ls-tree -r --name-only <sha> | grep -iE '\.(utm|ipsw|img|qcow2|iso|dmg)$'

rules.shortDescription: flake.lock changed by a commit that is not a nix flake update / update-input / flake lock change
rules.detect: git log --format='%h %s' origin/<default>~20..origin/<default> -- flake.lock; read each diff for an edit no lock command produces
rules.vacuousWhen: no commit in the range touched flake.lock

rules.shortDescription: A manifest repo is not cloned under ~/Developer
rules.detect: for each fleet-repos.txt line (read at origin/<default>): test -d ~/Developer/<repo>
rules.vacuousWhen: the manifest has zero repo lines

rules.shortDescription: A repo checkout has uncommitted changes (reported, never touched)
rules.detect: git -C <repo> status --porcelain

rules.shortDescription: A local branch already merged into the default branch (auto-fix in fix mode: delete)
rules.detect: git -C <repo> branch --merged origin/<default>, minus the default

rules.shortDescription: A local branch with commits on neither its remote nor the default branch
rules.detect: git -C <repo> branch --no-merged origin/<default>; git log --oneline <branch> --not --remotes

rules.shortDescription: A repo has more than one worktree
rules.detect: git -C <repo> worktree list

rules.shortDescription: The local default branch is ahead of or behind origin/<default>
rules.detect: git -C <repo> rev-list --left-right --count origin/<default>...<default>

rules.shortDescription: An open PR whose title breaks .claude/rules/pr-title.md
rules.detect: gh pr list --repo <owner>/<repo> --state open --json number,title,files
evidence: the title and the components its files touch

rules.shortDescription: An open PR with no activity for 7 days or more
rules.detect: gh pr list --json number,updatedAt; updatedAt older than 7 days

rules.shortDescription: An open PR sitting on a failed required check
rules.detect: gh pr list --json number,statusCheckRollup; any conclusion FAILURE/STARTUP_FAILURE
evidence: the failing check and its run URL

rules.shortDescription: A non-draft PR never armed: autoMergeRequest null and isInMergeQueue false
rules.detect: gh pr list --json autoMergeRequest,isDraft; isInMergeQueue via GraphQL

rules.shortDescription: A PR armed by anything but app/ismailkattakath-ci (GITHUB_TOKEN merges silently)
rules.detect: gh pr list --json autoMergeRequest; .autoMergeRequest.enabledBy.login

rules.shortDescription: A repo's latest CI run concluded red (failure or startup_failure)
rules.detect: gh run list --repo <owner>/<repo> --limit 1 --json workflowName,conclusion,url

rules.shortDescription: The composed /hygiene audit of nix-config exited 2 (findings or vacuous rules)
rules.detect: the hygiene run's SARIF: doctor-report verdict <file>; one finding ID per failing or vacuous rule

rules.shortDescription: The APFS container holding /nix has under 10% free
rules.detect: diskutil info /nix | grep -E 'Container Total Space|Container Free Space' (never df -h /nix)
evidence: Container Free Space and Total Space as printed

rules.shortDescription: determinate-nixd advises a newer Determinate Nix than the one running
rules.detect: determinate-nixd status 2>&1 | grep -m1 -i 'now available'
evidence: the running and the advised version

rules.shortDescription: A declared fleet launchd unit is not loaded
rules.detect: nix run .#launchd-doctor -- --json; sections.loaded[] with kind not-loaded

rules.shortDescription: A loaded fleet launchd unit's last exit was non-zero
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.loaded[] with kind nonzero-exit

rules.shortDescription: An installed plist no current generation declares
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.orphaned[] with kind orphaned (kind skipped = vacuous)
rules.vacuousWhen: sections.orphaned holds only kind skipped (no generation manifest)

rules.shortDescription: A launchd log over LAUNCHD_DOCTOR_WARN_KB (a broken rotator)
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.logSize[] with kind log-over-threshold

rules.shortDescription: launchd's disabled-DB holds a fleet label (bootstrap fails with error 119)
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.disabled[]
evidence: the remedy line the doctor printed

rules.shortDescription: A ~/Library/Logs file no installed unit writes
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.strayLogs[] with kind candidate

rules.shortDescription: A caffeinate with no utility, -t or -w (the Mac never sleeps again)
rules.detect: launchd-doctor --json; sections.powerAssertions[] with kind unbounded

rules.shortDescription: A server-denied plugin still starts an MCP server, or the AWS path is not exactly one
rules.detect: the three claude mcp list | grep -c lines in fleet-doctor § E4 (must print 0, 0, 1)
evidence: the server name that slipped the deny
rules.vacuousWhen: claude mcp list printed zero servers

rules.shortDescription: A plugin enabled live but declared neither in Nix nor in the overlay
rules.detect: the jq in fleet-doctor § E5 over the declared, overlay and live enabledPlugins (declared read at the subject SHA)
rules.vacuousWhen: the live enabledPlugins map is empty

rules.shortDescription: A terranix stack shows drift in the daily summary
rules.detect: jq '.stacks[] | select(.status=="drift")' ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/nix-config-terranix-drift/summary.json

rules.shortDescription: A terranix stack needs a Google re-login
rules.detect: summary.json .stacks[] with status reauth
evidence: the re-login command from its log

rules.shortDescription: A terranix stack's plan errored
rules.detect: summary.json .stacks[] with status error; read <stack>.log beside it

rules.shortDescription: The drift summary is missing or finished more than 26 hours ago (the agent did not run)
rules.detect: jq .finished summary.json against now
rules.vacuousWhen: never: a missing file is itself the finding

rules.shortDescription: A healthchecks.io check is down
rules.detect: the healthchecks.io v3 checks API (fleet-doctor § E7); status down

rules.shortDescription: A check still new after its job has had a scheduled run since the ping was wired
rules.detect: status new; trace fleet.heartbeats, the pingers map and gh run list per fleet-doctor § E7
evidence: the scheduled run after the wiring commit

rules.shortDescription: nixpi has a failed systemd unit
rules.detect: ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 nixpi systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain

rules.shortDescription: A longRunning nixpi unit (modules/_lib/nixpi-units.nix) is not active
rules.detect: systemctl is-active <longRunning units>; the oneshot list is never flagged
rules.vacuousWhen: nixpi was unreachable, or the longRunning list is empty

rules.shortDescription: nixpi did not answer one SSH call within 10 s (skipped, never retried)
rules.detect: the E8 ssh call's exit code
evidence: the ssh exit code and stderr's last line
rules.vacuousWhen: never: one ssh attempt is always made

rules.shortDescription: The latest warm-nixpi-cache run on main did not succeed
rules.detect: gh run list --workflow warm-nixpi-cache.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json conclusion,url
rules.vacuousWhen: the workflow has no run on main

rules.shortDescription: A nixpi-closure path changed after the last warm-nixpi-cache headSha
rules.detect: git diff --name-only <headSha> origin/main against the workflow's paths: filter
rules.vacuousWhen: the workflow has no run on main

rules.shortDescription: The main checkout that activate builds is behind origin/<default>
rules.detect: git -C <main checkout> rev-list --count HEAD..origin/<default>; and its branch name
rules.vacuousWhen: never: the main checkout always exists on macos

rules.shortDescription: /run/current-system is not the system that origin/<default> builds (a landed change is not activated)
rules.detect: readlink /run/current-system vs nix eval --raw <snapshot>#darwinConfigurations.macos.config.system.build.toplevel.outPath (an eval queries no cache; never a --dry-run, which negative-caches 404s)
rules.vacuousWhen: the subject's out path could not be computed (say why)

rules.shortDescription: A declared marketplace is missing from ~/.claude/settings.json extraKnownMarketplaces (proves a stale tree)
rules.detect: compare declared extraKnownMarketplaces (subject SHA) with the live settings file; an absent https plugin alone is normal
